turn_5_1.en:
/softgames-closewin We need to audit what we have built so far. Look, when golden seeds are enabled and I click calibrate with the checkbox checked, there is a logical flaw: the calibration tool searches across hand sizes / deck sizes, but when evaluating on a fixed golden seed, we run with a single fixed hand size. So that makes no logical sense. Let's perform a logical audit of what is happening there. On golden seeds, we should show the win rates across different player personas (Casual, Medium, Pro) evaluated via Monte Carlo simulations. I think we need to decouple this logic. That is, the logic should be: calibration determines how many cards should be in the deck/hand, while golden seeds are used for testing across different player personas, plotting the benchmark results on a chart (e.g., 3 personas: Pro, Medium, Casual). I also think we need to streamline the UI. We should combine this entire process into a single button—"Analyze Level"—and display a complete calibration dashboard across different targets. We need to design this dashboard.
The goal of this session is an audit and design of how we assemble and lay all of this out.
